title: Protect the Chickens
learning_outcomes: An event starts from a sensor observation
A rule turns an observation into a safe action

steps.instruction: WatchTower watches the property with three cameras, day and night.

instruction_layers.young: The farm is calm. The WatchTower is keeping watch.
instruction_layers.beginner: WatchTower watches the property with three cameras, day and night.
instruction_layers.advanced: WatchTower (tc:device:watchtower:wt_001) runs a predator model on the device and publishes alerts on tc/wt_001/alert.
instruction_layers.teacher: Ask: what could a camera notice at night that a person might miss?

details: Open the Demo page.
Find the list on the 3D view called 'Autonomous farm - simulated'.
Find the WatchTower line: 'Scanning 360° for predators'.
That's the camera tower watching the property, day and night.
steps.watch_out: WatchTower only sees; it never chases animals away by itself.

steps.instruction: Trigger the event: the WatchTower camera spots a fox near the coop.

instruction_layers.young: Uh oh! The camera saw something. Press the button to find out.
instruction_layers.beginner: Trigger the event: the WatchTower camera spots a fox near the coop.
instruction_layers.advanced: The camera classifies a fox at 87% confidence; the predator rule needs at least 80% and dusk or animals outside.
instruction_layers.teacher: Discuss confidence: why not act at 50%?

details: Press 'Trigger the predator event' below - or open Trigger an Event in the left menu.
Find the card 'Predator detected' (top left).
Press its Trigger button.
Watch the panel on the right fill with the event chain.
steps.look_for: A new event: the camera spotted a fox near the coop.
steps.watch_out: Press Trigger once and wait a second - each press makes a new event.

steps.instruction: Find the Chicken Tender coop near the camera - its flock is at risk.

instruction_layers.young: Which house are the chickens in? That's the one to protect.
instruction_layers.beginner: Find the Chicken Tender coop near the camera - its flock is at risk.
instruction_layers.advanced: The rule maps the detection to the nearest guarded habitat twin (Chicken Tender, ct_001).
instruction_layers.teacher: Ask learners to point to it on the map and explain why it was chosen.

shot.label: The coop is on the list

details: Open the Property Twin (left menu).
Find the 'Needs attention' list on the 3D view.
Find the fox alert and the coop it is near.
Ask: who could get hurt? (the chickens in that coop)
steps.look_for: The predator alert listed under Needs attention.
steps.watch_out: Several alerts can be listed - look for the fox one.

steps.instruction: Open "Why did this happen?" and follow camera → rule → door.

instruction_layers.young: Ask "Why?" - the computer tells you each step.
instruction_layers.beginner: Open "Why did this happen?" and follow camera → rule → door.
instruction_layers.advanced: Read the engineer chain: device → AI → rule → OS → actuator → action → notify, each with its live source type.
instruction_layers.teacher: Have learners retell the chain in their own words.

demo.label: Open the event and its Why

details: On Trigger an Event, scroll down to the Event log.
Find the newest line: 'Chicken Tender door closed and you were alerted'.
Click 'Why did this happen?' to open it.
Try the three buttons: For kids, For farmers, For engineers.
steps.look_for: An explanation that names the camera, the rule and the door.
steps.watch_out: Pick 'For kids' for the simplest words.

steps.instruction: The safe response is to close the coop door - and tell the owner.

instruction_layers.young: The door closes to keep the chickens safe.
instruction_layers.beginner: The safe response is to close the coop door - and tell the owner.
instruction_layers.advanced: The OS checks E-STOP is clear, commands the door and only counts it closed when the limit switch confirms.
instruction_layers.teacher: Ask: what should happen if the door does not confirm it closed?

details: Look at the event chain on the right of Trigger an Event.
Read it from top to bottom: WatchTower camera → Vision model → Predator rule → Tender Cells OS → door controller → coop door.
Find the last line: the door closed and the owner was alerted.
steps.look_for: The chain ends with the coop door closed and an owner alert.
steps.watch_out: The 'Physical action' row is simulated here - nothing real moves.

steps.instruction: Next: build a camera node that does this for real.

instruction_layers.young: You can build a real camera like this one!
instruction_layers.beginner: Next: build a camera node that does this for real.
instruction_layers.advanced: Camera Node: XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense, flashed from /flash, streams on your network (no upload).
instruction_layers.teacher: Bridge to the camera / sensor build path.

details: Open the Property Twin and the Chicken Tender card.
Press 'See hardware'.
Read the chain from the twin down to the real coop door.
Next mission: build a camera node that does this for real.
steps.look_for: How Demo Chicken Tender 001 becomes real - a list from twin to real door.
steps.watch_out: Real builds need an adult's help with tools and power.
